description:
You are a Computer User Support Specialist who just finished a phone call with a customer. You need to log this phone interaction in FreeScout so the support team has a record of the call.

Create a PHONE conversation (not an email conversation) in the 'IT Support' mailbox. When creating a new conversation, you must switch the type from Email to Phone by clicking the phone icon in the new conversation form before filling in the details.

Use the following details:
- Mailbox: IT Support
- Customer: David Chen (david.chen@acmecorp.com)
- Subject: Network Printer Not Detected - HP LaserJet Pro M404n
- Body: Customer called regarding HP LaserJet Pro M404n printer not showing up on his Windows 11 workstation. Verified printer is online and reachable at 192.168.1.45. Cleared Windows print spooler and re-added printer via IP. Printer now detected and test page printed successfully. Customer confirmed issue resolved.

IMPORTANT: You must select the Phone conversation type (phone icon) rather than the default Email type. This is critical - a regular email conversation will not satisfy the requirement.

The FreeScout admin interface is at http://localhost:8080
Login credentials: admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!
